segments.contextAfter: Capture a GPU trace using Metal Debugger to analyze a set of related Metal calls, such as all commands used to render a single frame of animation. Metal Debugger collects data from Metal API calls, analyzes the resulting GPU trace, and provides suggestions to fix errors or improve performance. For example, modern game engines require dozens of passes and thousands of GPU commands to render complex scenes. Metal Debugger can find dependencies between passes and uncover places where you incorrectly generate or store data. Not all of Metal Debugger’s suggestions are problems you must fix. You decide whether or not to act on each suggestion. For more information, see [`Metal debugger`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Xcode/Metal-debugger).
